commit_message:
avcodec/dovi_rpuenc: add ff_dovi_configure_ext()

More flexible version of ff_dovi_configure() which does not require an
AVCodecContext. Usable, for example, inside a bitstream filter.

findings.title: Use-after-free via avcodec_parameters_to_context invalidating coded_side_data pointers
findings.message: ff_dovi_configure() round-trips through an intermediate AVCodecParameters by calling avcodec_parameters_from_context() and then avcodec_parameters_to_context(). The call to avcodec_parameters_to_context(avctx, codecpar) at line 226 internally calls av_packet_side_data_free(&codec->coded_side_data, &codec->nb_coded_side_data), which frees ALL existing coded_side_data entries on the AVCodecContext (including any AVCPBProperties previously allocated via ff_encode_add_cpb_side_data()). It then replaces coded_side_data with a copy from the intermediate codecpar. Any caller that holds a pointer into the old coded_side_data (e.g., cpb_props in libaomenc.c obtained before calling ff_dovi_configure) now has a dangling pointer, leading to a heap-use-after-free when that pointer is subsequently written to.
findings.suggestion: Avoid the round-trip through AVCodecParameters entirely. Instead, pass the individual fields from AVCodecContext directly to the configuration function, and write side data directly to avctx->coded_side_data rather than going through an intermediate codecpar that triggers free+copy of the context's side data.

ground_truth.root_cause: The introduction of ff_dovi_configure_ext() changed ff_dovi_configure() from operating directly on AVCodecContext fields to using an intermediate AVCodecParameters round-trip. The avcodec_parameters_to_context() call at the end frees and replaces avctx->coded_side_data as a side effect, which is surprising and invalidates pointers held by callers. The fundamental issue is using a destructive copy-back mechanism (avcodec_parameters_to_context) when the caller may hold pointers into the data being replaced.
